component_data_script:
raw_rows = props.get("projects") or []
if isinstance(raw_rows, str):
	try:
		raw_rows = json.loads(raw_rows)
	except Exception:
		raw_rows = [line for line in raw_rows.split("\n") if line.strip()]
if not isinstance(raw_rows, list):
	raw_rows = []
rows = []
for raw in raw_rows:
	try:
		parts = [part.strip() for part in str(raw).split("|")]
		while len(parts) < 10:
			parts.append("")
		if parts[0] or parts[1]:
			rows.append(parts)
	except Exception:
		continue

labels = [part.strip() for part in str(props.get("stage_labels") or "Sketch | Prototype | Shipped").split("|")]
while len(labels) < 3:
	labels.append("")
link_label = str(props.get("link_label") or "").strip() or "Read the case study"
request_label = str(props.get("request_label") or "").strip() or "Case study on request"
projects = []
for parts in rows:
	try:
		focus = [point.strip() for point in parts[9].split(",")]
		while len(focus) < 3:
			focus.append("")
		name = parts[0]
		href = parts[8]
		projects.append({
			"name": name,
			"line": parts[1],
			"client": parts[2],
			"year": parts[3],
			"made": parts[4],
			"has_client": len(parts[2]) > 0,
			"has_year": len(parts[3]) > 0,
			"has_made": len(parts[4]) > 0,
			"sketch_src": parts[5],
			"proto_src": parts[6],
			"ship_src": parts[7],
			"sketch_alt": name + ", " + labels[0].lower(),
			"proto_alt": name + ", " + labels[1].lower(),
			"ship_alt": name + ", " + labels[2].lower(),
			"sketch_focus": focus[0] or "50% 50%",
			"proto_focus": focus[1] or "50% 50%",
			"ship_focus": focus[2] or "50% 50%",
			"has_sketch": len(parts[5]) > 0,
			"has_proto": len(parts[6]) > 0,
			"has_ship": len(parts[7]) > 0,
			"link": href,
			"has_link": len(href) > 0,
			"no_link": len(href) == 0,
			"link_label": link_label,
			"request_label": request_label,
		})
	except Exception:
		continue
component.projects = projects
